text:
alex: Heads up — alerting webhook to #incidents started failing at ~17:30 UTC. We had a prod 500 on notify-svc but the on-call team didn't get paged. Anyone seeing pages?

ops-bot: incident-bot delivery failed for alert id=alert-7821 status=422 signature_mismatch :warning:

sre-oncall: I didn't receive any page. Saw the metric spike in dashboards and a flurry of retries. I'm oncall now.

maria: Confirmed from monitoring — retries visible, but delivery to paging provider shows 4xx. No automatic escalation triggered.

alex: Trying a manual resend to the bot endpoint to see error details:
```
curl -X POST https://incident-bot.internal/webhook \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Sig: long-signature-example-that-might-get-truncated-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' \n  -d '{"alert":"prod-500","ts":1735555012}'
```

ops-bot: resend returned 401 Unauthorized and gateway logs show "header too long, truncated" for X-Sig. Also logged: "signature verification failure".

nina: That lines up with earlier nginx change in front of incident-bot that rewrites headers >3k. Looks like our sig header now exceeds the new threshold after adding the pk blob.

jon: Manual mitigation in progress: sending SMS to the on-call and doing an immediate phone escalation. @sre-oncall did you get an SMS? :phone:

sre-oncall: Got the SMS and a direct call. I'm following the manual runbook (page fallback -> owner escalation -> customer impact assessment). Switching to manual until we fix the webhook.

maria: I've disabled auto-silence on that alert and bumped alert priority so it won't be auto-suppressed by the incident pipeline.

alex: Short-term fix: rotate webhook key to use a compact HMAC (short-hash) and push a hotfix to incident-bot to accept both header forms. Long-term: add header-length test in staging and update proxy config to preserve headers.

ops-bot: Pager delivery log: manual_page_id=pg-559 status=sent via sms-provider v2.1.

jon: Action items: 1) rotate sig format (alex), 2) nginx proxy rollback or config tweak (nina), 3) add delivery-rate alert for incident-bot (maria), 4) add auto-fallback when 4xx delivery occurs (sre team). I'll create a short RFC for auto-fallback behavior.

maria: I'll open the postmortem ticket and link runbook steps + timeline. Also tagging customer-impact for product to triage any affected tenants.

alex: Thanks all. For the retro: test header truncation in CI, make the signature header space-efficient, and ensure incident-bot can trigger manual paging automatically on delivery errors.

pagerbot: NOTE: incident-bot will accept legacy short-sig until 1735680000.

jon: Closing the live thread — continuing mitigation work in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
